scenario: The ego vehicle merges onto a multi-lane highway from an on-ramp while two other vehicles travel in the adjacent highway lanes.

ego.behavior: The car accelerates along the on-ramp and merges into the highway traffic flow.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight forward in the rightmost highway lane, maintaining a consistent speed as the ego vehicle merges ahead of it.
The car travels straight forward in the middle highway lane, parallel to the other highway vehicle.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle starts on a curved on-ramp that joins a multi-lane highway from the right, with two adversarial cars already traveling on the main highway lanes; residential buildings line the left side of the highway and dense forest borders the right side.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must spawn on the on-ramp and successfully merge into highway traffic without collision; the scenario terminates once the ego has fully merged and traveled a certain distance along the highway.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned alongside the on-ramp near the merge point with the highway.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the vehicle on the on-ramp; two highway vehicles are adversarials. 2. Enumeration: adversarials length is 2. 3. Chronology: initially ego is on ramp, two cars on highway; midpoint ego accelerates and approaches merge; ending ego merges into right highway lane ahead of trailing adversarial. 4. Evidence: ego's path curves from ramp onto highway; lateral position shifts from right shoulder to lane; distance to trailing car increases after merge.
